name: PeeringDB Plus availability
description: Share of routed HTTP requests that return a status below 500, over 28 days. Health probes, POST /sync and unrouted requests (no http_route) are left out.

annotations.value: PeeringDB Plus burns its availability error budget fast

5xx responses on routed requests burn the 28-day error budget of the availability SLO (99.9%) at 14.4 times the sustainable rate over 1h and 5m, or 6 times over 6h and 30m. Break the errors down by http_route and cloud_region (dashboard pdbplus-overview, Error Rate (5xx)), then read the ERROR logs of those machines.
PeeringDB Plus burns its availability error budget

5xx responses on routed requests burn the 28-day error budget of the availability SLO (99.9%) at 3 times the sustainable rate over 24h and 2h, or 1 time over 72h and 6h. Break the errors down by http_route and cloud_region (dashboard pdbplus-overview, Error Rate (5xx)), then read the ERROR logs of those machines.
